title: Bias Beyond Borders: Political Ideology Evaluation and Steering in Multilingual LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and mitigating political bias and ideological leanings across multilingual LLMs using the Political Compass Test (PCT). While it acknowledges that political identity can be tied to religious and regional ideologies, the core of its benchmarking and framework (CLAS) is concerned with economic and social axes of political orientation rather than a primary evaluation of religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems.
